description: Team Blue Sphere - Alpha: two Python developers from Metro Atlanta building a fire safety dashboard from NASA microgravity combustion data. I’m an AI startup tech-founder and my team mate is a Sr. AI Engineer. We scope tightly, ship a working demo, and trace every insight to its source. Looking for:  someone with combustion or aerospace knowledge to check our science, and a storyteller for the demo video. No NASA data experience needed, just reliability and curiosity.
